Direct eye-crop inference
MediaPipe Iris model (Google); TensorFlow.js graph conversion by Vladimir Mandic.
Model source: https://github.com/vladmandic/human-models/tree/main/models (iris.json, iris.bin).
Model metadata identifies google/mediapipe as its generator and vladmandic as converter.
Original model: https://storage.googleapis.com/mediapipe-assets/iris_landmark.tflite
Conversion repository license: Iris-model-LICENSE.txt (MIT).
TensorFlow.js and its WASM backend, pinned version 4.22.0: TensorFlow-LICENSE.txt (Apache 2.0).
The application uses its own eye-region selection, feature extraction and validation.
These models estimate eye landmarks; they do not directly provide screen gaze coordinates.
Models and inference assets are bundled locally; camera images are never uploaded.
